DeployBot: starting staged rollout: service=inference-api model=v2.4.1 cohort=LATAM initial=3% planned bump=15% at +10m. /deploy start --staged=3%
Nina: note: tokenization tweak in this build may increase token counts for multi-turn prompts. Recommend 3% smoke only.
Aamir (oncall): holding until auth and latency p99 look stable for 5m.
Joel: infra: pin to gc-tuned pool and throttle hotstarts to 6s.
DeployBot: canary active at 3%. Hooks: auth.login.fail, latency.p99, tokenizer.token_count.delta, recall.long_prompt.
Telemetry: tokenizer.token_count.delta = +2.9% (warn 3.0%) at 02:12 UTC. recall.long_prompt = +0.7%.
Nina: close to warning. keep at 3% soak for full 10m before bump.
Aamir (oncall): auth and p99 ok. still holding on recall threshold.
Telemetry: after bump attempt to 15% at 02:23 UTC, recall.long_prompt = +2.2% (threshold 1.5%).
Aamir (oncall): stopping rollout. recall regression unacceptable. Stop + rollback to v2.3.2.
DeployBot: rollback initiated: `/deploy rollback --to=model=v2.3.2`
InfraBot: scaling v2.4.1 down, reinstating v2.3.2; expect ~60s bleed.
ReleaseNotesBot: add note: "v2.4.1 LATAM canary halted due to long-prompt recall regression after bump to 15%; rolled back to v2.3.2. Action: revert tokenizer change and run extended recall soak."
Joel: adding runbook snippet to thread for quick rollback.
DeployBot: thread closed by automation after rollback.
